title: Bigelow refuses to return; negative experiences hit his family

tellings.quote: he had such negative experiences. It it impacted his family.

plain: On a podcast with host Jesse Michels, the current owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for strange happenings, spoke about its former owner Robert Bigelow, a wealthy businessman, with mention of the journalist George Knapp. He says Bigelow will not go back to the ranch because he had such bad experiences there that they affected his family. If true, it suggests whatever is at the ranch can follow people home.
